introduction: Tennessee weatherization applications go through the agency serving your county. Ask for its application and current home-assessment requirements.
description: Tennessee weatherization applications go through the agency serving your county. Ask for its application and current home-assessment requirements.

sections.who: The program serves qualifying households with energy-efficiency needs. A home’s structural condition can prevent work until other repairs are completed.
sections.get: Measures can include insulation, air sealing, ventilation and heating or cooling improvements selected through assessment.
sections.docs:
• Household income information.
  • Home and utility details.
  • Owner or building-manager permissions requested by the agency.
sections.apply:
1. Find county intake

    Use THDA’s program directory.

  2. Request the application

    Ask the local agency whether it accepts paper, email or online submissions.

  3. Arrange assessment

    Discuss structural concerns and any waiting list before expecting work.
sections.after: Keep provider contact details and ask about the audit’s proposed measures. Apartment residents should discuss coordination with the building manager.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using THDA program, State explanation of actual intake and assessment. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is this a general renovation program?
The state article describes an energy-efficiency focus and notes that structural repairs may need another program first.
The state explains that approved households can be placed on a waiting list before an audit.
The state says local offices use different submission arrangements.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
